notes: Safaricom Daraja (M-Pesa and related Safaricom APIs) authored from the developer portal's own documentation, read through the portal's GraphQL backend (getApis + populateApi for all 30 catalogue entries). 52 operations cover every documented endpoint: OAuth, M-Pesa Express push and query, C2B register/simulate (v1, which the adaptor uses, kept and marked deprecated, plus v2), B2C v3, B2Pochi, Transaction Status, Account Balance, Reversal, B2B remit tax and payment request (pay bill / buy goods / B2C account top-up share one path), B2B Express Checkout, Dynamic QR, Bill Manager (7), Pull Transactions (2), the Swap/IMSI/Age-on-Network/KYC/Hakikisha lookups, Lipa na Bonga (2), Mobile Data Bundles (3), M-Pesa Ratiba and IoT SIM Management (12). Schemas are inferred from the docs' sample bodies with descriptions from their parameter tables; several samples are not valid JSON (Bill Manager invoices, Dynamic QR response) and were transcribed, and the docs' 'Command ID' key typo is normalised to CommandID. Asynchronous outcomes are webhooks, not responses: ResultCallback, StkCallback, C2BTransactionNotification, C2BValidationResponse, BillManagerPayment, RatibaCallback and the others are components.schemas only. Phone numbers, names, emails, credentials and the base64 QR image in vendor samples are replaced with placeholders. HTTP methods are POST except the token and the two Mobile Data Bundles GETs, per the docs' rule 'all M-PESA APIs are POST except Authorization'. Adaptor check: stkPush, checkTransactionStatus, registerUrl (c2b v1), remitTax, buyGoods and the token call all map to modelled paths.
